offering_description.value: Operates an online marketplace where travelers book vacation rentals and other stays, local experiences, and services such as private chefs and photography. Local professionals can list their services for review and accept bookings through the platform.

quotes.quote: Get an Airbnb for every kind of trip → 8 million vacation rentals → 2 million Guest Favorites → multiple countries and regions worldwide

Airbnb Services is a marketplace for high-quality services that make a guest’s stay even better. Services include catering, chefs, hair styling, makeup, massage, personal training, photography, prepared meals, and spa treatments. It’s easy to get started. First, share a little about yourself and the service you offer. Then, add photos, set your pricing, and submit your listing for review. We may get back to you with suggested changes, requests to upload licenses, or to ask for proof of insurance. Once your listing is approved, you can publish it and start offering your service to customers immediately. Get started. It’s free to create and submit a listing for review. Airbnb automatically deducts a 15% service fee from the payout of every service booked.
